horseshoeCrab: Lad, I must thank you for listening to this old soul’s ramblings.
Do you wish to hear tales of old? It is rare for one like you to be willing to listen to… an old fool.
Though one’s compatriots no longer walk the same path, the currents and the soil still whisper their voices, as they call one to the other shore.

In ages past, we swam from claws that stretched from the abyss and maws that could swallow us whole. Still, one must correct one’s words. Those claws and maws have vanished from the tangible world, but they still live within our hearts.
Does one know how to do a “sick wheelie”? …Of course one once did, one is just an old geezer with arthritis now alright?!?!
The sea scorpions are gone, but so are one’s closest companions… Coral, Pearl, Finn, where are you all now?
By the time one found the scorpion cave, all that was left was their exoskeletons. Had one not abandoned them that day…maybe one wouldn’t be so alone right now.
One personally believes those cold corporate reefs are not so different from those scorpion caves. It is just that a different predator lurks in the shadows…
One should have skipped training more often and watched their performances. Young lad, don’t waste your life away at this kiosk, especially for an ungrateful power.

My memories… Pearl used to dance as a side job at the nearby atoll, and Coral played the tubes in the sea symphony. Finn’s claw-to-claw combat was uncontested… but he and his sand paintings were more beautiful. Make sure to treasure the ones you love.
Young lad, do not weep for me. This was a fate long destined that I had run away from for far too long. Since you have heard this sinner’s confessions, you know that I must atone for my sins.
I woke up from a beautiful dream this morn. There were no bleached corals, but old reefs and familiar faces calling me. Therefore, I shall depart for the other shore.
